<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" width="1200" height="300" viewBox="0 0 1200 300">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="shade" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#0a0508" stop-opacity="0.92"/>
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#0a0508" stop-opacity="0.7"/>
      <stop offset="75%" stop-color="#0a0508" stop-opacity="0.1"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0a0508" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="txt" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#ffb3cc"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="gradientTransform" type="translate" from="-1 0" to="1 0" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="line" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff7aa8"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ff7aa8" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <clipPath id="frame"><rect width="1200" height="300" rx="18"/></clipPath>
    <clipPath id="type"><rect x="70" y="80" height="100" width="0">
      <animate attributeName="width" values="0;540;540;0" keyTimes="0;0.35;0.85;1" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite" calcMode="spline" keySplines="0.4 0 0.2 1;0 0 1 1;0.4 0 0.2 1"/>
    </rect></clipPath>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: 'SG'; font-weight: 700; src: url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2'); }
      @font-face { font-family: 'SG'; font-weight: 400; src: url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2'); }
            .t { font-family: 'SG', 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; }
      .m { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace; }
      .bg { transform-origin: 900px 150px; animation: zoom 20s ease-in-out infinite; }
      .cursor { animation: blink 1s steps(1) infinite; }
      .sub { opacity: 0; animation: fade 7s ease-in-out infinite; }
      .p { animation-name: fall; animation-timing-function: linear; animation-iteration-count: infinite; }
      @keyframes zoom { 0%,100% { transform: scale(1) } 50% { transform: scale(1.08) } }
      @keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0 } }
      @keyframes fade { 0%,30% { opacity: 0 } 40%,85% { opacity: 1 } 95%,100% { opacity: 0 } }
      @keyframes fall { 0% { transform: translate(0,0) rotate(0deg) } 100% { transform: translate(var(--dx),330px) rotate(360deg) } }
    </style>
  </defs>
  <g clip-path="url(#frame)">
    <image class="bg" width="1200" height="300" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice" xlink:href="data:image/jpeg;base64,"/>
    <rect width="1200" height="300" fill="url(#shade)"/>
    <g class="p" style="--dx:17px;animation-duration:12.7s;animation-delay:-5.1s"><ellipse cx="663" cy="-10" rx="3.2" ry="2.0" fill="#ffc2d6" opacity="0.85"/></g><g class="p" style="--dx:-111px;animation-duration:9.2s;animation-delay:-0.8s"><ellipse cx="192" cy="-10" rx="4.8" ry="3.1" fill="#ffc2d6" opacity="0.85"/></g><g class="p" style="--dx:-109px;animation-duration:10.5s;animation-delay:-5.2s"><ellipse cx="126" cy="-10" rx="6.4" ry="4.1" fill="#ffc2d6" opacity="0.85"/></g><g class="p" style="--dx:-90px;animation-duration:12.2s;animation-delay:-3.8s"><ellipse cx="1140" cy="-10" rx="3.5" ry="2.2" fill="#ffc2d6" opacity="0.85"/></g><g class="p" style="--dx:26px;animation-duration:10.4s;animation-delay:-8.9s"><ellipse cx="631" cy="-10" rx="3.4" ry="2.2" fill="#ffc2d6" opacity="0.85"/></g><g class="p" style="--dx:-105px;animation-duration:9.2s;animation-delay:-7.1s"><ellipse cx="384" cy="-10" rx="3.2" ry="2.1" fill="#ffc2d6" opacity="0.85"/></g><g class="p" style="--dx:-1px;animation-duration:10.0s;animation-delay:-6.9s"><ellipse cx="421" cy="-10" rx="5.7" ry="3.7" fill="#ffc2d6" opacity="0.85"/></g><g class="p" style="--dx:-58px;animation-duration:9.2s;animation-delay:-3.2s"><ellipse cx="928" cy="-10" rx="3.6" ry="2.3" fill="#ffc2d6" opacity="0.85"/></g><g class="p" style="--dx:-6px;animation-duration:10.4s;animation-delay:-6.8s"><ellipse cx="167" cy="-10" rx="6.1" ry="3.9" fill="#ffc2d6" opacity="0.85"/></g><g class="p" style="--dx:-78px;animation-duration:10.7s;animation-delay:-1.0s"><ellipse cx="589" cy="-10" rx="4.8" ry="3.1" fill="#ffc2d6" opacity="0.85"/></g><g class="p" style="--dx:51px;animation-duration:7.9s;animation-delay:-6.4s"><ellipse cx="700" cy="-10" rx="3.1" ry="2.0" fill="#ffc2d6" opacity="0.85"/></g><g class="p" style="--dx:-40px;animation-duration:11.6s;animation-delay:-7.4s"><ellipse cx="158" cy="-10" rx="6.1" ry="3.9" fill="#ffc2d6" opacity="0.85"/></g>
    <text x="72" y="70" class="m" font-size="16" fill="#ff9ec0" opacity="0.8">~/github $ whoami</text>
    <g clip-path="url(#type)">
      <text x="70" y="160" class="t" font-size="72" font-weight="700" fill="url(#txt)">Hi! I&#39;m W1nLyX</text>
    </g>
    <rect class="cursor" x="70" y="108" width="5" height="60" fill="#ff7aa8">
      <animate attributeName="x" values="70;580;580;70" keyTimes="0;0.35;0.85;1" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite" calcMode="spline" keySplines="0.4 0 0.2 1;0 0 1 1;0.4 0 0.2 1"/>
    </rect>
    <text x="72" y="210" class="t sub" font-size="23" font-weight="400" fill="#f3d6e0"><tspan fill="#ff7aa8">&gt;</tspan> developer · infrastructure · networks</text>
    <rect x="72" y="232" width="320" height="2" fill="url(#line)" class="sub"/>
  </g>
</svg>
